what: Per-token decode op graph of DeepSeek's reference inference (reference/deepseek-inference, vendored verbatim from 1bae0e10) at MP=1, plus the DSpark draft path. Companion to docs/M0-PORT-PLAN.md section 1.

notation.impl: tilelang = kernel.py JIT kernel; torch = plain PyTorch op(s); host = Python/CPU work or a device->host sync
notation.shape_6row: DSpark verify step, b=1, s=6 (target forward over last token + 5 drafts). NOT implemented by the reference (model.py:129-130); shapes are what our extend path must feed the same ops
notation.T: context length at this step; T/r = compressed entries (r = compress ratio)
notation.fp8_linear: act_quant (tilelang, FP8 E4M3 + E8M0 block 32, kernel.py:98-124) then fp8_gemm (tilelang, kernel.py:207-307), via linear() model.py:196-205
notation.fp4_linear: act_quant then fp4_gemm (tilelang, kernel.py:477-591), via linear() model.py:186-195

decode_target.op: engram n-gram hash ids for both Engram layers
token embedding
expand to hc copies; identity pre_mix
Engram: lookup 24 rows (fp8 + e8m0 scale), dequant to bf16, wkv fp8_linear K=6144 N=25600, per-copy gate (signed-sqrt sigmoid), h += gate*value
DSpark target capture: mean over hc copies of the attention input (only when DSpark is on)
hc_mixes for attention: rms over flattened 20480, F.linear fp32 by hc_attn_fn[24,20480], then Sinkhorn split -> pre/post/comb
collapse hc copies with the PREVIOUS layer's ffn_pre (identity at layer 0)
RMSNorm eps 1e-20
wq_a fp8_linear N=1280 K=5120; q_norm; wq_b fp8_linear N=32768 K=1280; RoPE on last 64 dims
wkv fp8_linear N=512 K=5120; kv_norm; RoPE; FP8 QDQ in place (whole 512 incl. rope); write ring slot start_pos%128; window indices oldest-first
decode_target.shape_6row: needs extend path (decode branch assumes s=1, model.py:719)

decode_target.op: ratio 2 (2,8,14): fp32 F.linear wkv+wgate N=512 into a 2-slot state, softmax-pool + RMSNorm when the group completes (every 2nd step); ratio 1 (20): bf16 F.linear + RMSNorm every step

owners (2,8,14,20): wk bf16 N=128, k_norm, RoPE, FP4 QDQ (E8M0 block 32), append to k_cache. All: wq_b fp8_linear N=4096 K=1280, RoPE, FP4 QDQ; weights_proj bf16 N=32; bf16 einsum q.k -> relu * weights -> sum heads; layer 20 picks candidate blocks (8-wide, top 2048); 24-36 mask to candidates; topk min(512,T/r), sort, +128 offset
reuse shared_attn.topk_idxs from the last index source
RoPE on latent at group position, FP4 QDQ with E4M3 block-16 scales, write compress_kv_cache
torch.cat(window ring, compressed cache[:T/r]) and cat indices -- copies the whole compressed cache every layer every step
gathered sparse MLA-style attention with per-head sink; one CTA per (query row, batch); 64 heads in one CTA at MP=1
inverse RoPE on o; FP8 QDQ per group; wo_a block-diagonal bf16 einsum [8 groups,1024,4096]; wo_b fp8_linear N=5120 K=8192
decode_target.impl: torch einsum + tilelang act_quant + tilelang fp8_linear

decode_target.op: expand sublayer output back to hc copies, mix residual through comb
hc_mixes for FFN -> ffn_pre (returned for the NEXT layer's attention), ffn_post, ffn_comb; collapse with attn_pre; ffn_norm
fp32 F.linear N=384; sqrt(softplus); topk 6 on scores+bias; weights from unbiased scores, normalize (+1e-20), *1.5
bincount(...).tolist() -- device-to-host sync, blocks CUDA-graph capture

Python loop over active experts: torch.where gather; w1,w3 fp4_linear N=2304 K=5120 (output bf16 -> fp32); clamp up to +-10, gate to <=10; silu*up*weight; w2 fp4_linear N=5120 K=2304; y[idx] += in fp32, expert-id order
decode_target.impl: torch loop + tilelang act_quant/fp4_gemm (3 GEMMs + 3 quants per expert)
decode_target.shape_6row: up to 36 distinct experts, M=rows routed to each

decode_target.op: shared expert, FP8 weights, same clamped SwiGLU, added to y
expand + residual mix
collapse with layer 39's ffn_pre; final RMSNorm
head: fp32 F.linear N=129280 K=5120 (weight held fp32, bf16 on disk)
sample: argmax at temperature 0, Gumbel-max otherwise

dspark_draft.op: forward_embed: main_proj fp8_linear N=5120 K=15360 on cat(layer 37/38/39 captures); main_norm; draft ids = [last token, noise x4]; shared embed; expand hc

3 x DSparkBlock (layers 40-42): main_kv from main_x into window ring; q/kv for 5 draft rows at positions start_pos+1..+5; each draft row sees the ring plus all 5 block rows; sparse_attn; o path; MoE with 128 experts top-3
forward_head: shared fp32 head -> logits[1,5,129280]; sequential Markov loop x5 (bf16 embed[129280,256] + fp32 head[129280,256] bias, sample next draft); confidence head fp32 [5376->1]
verify the 6-row block on the target and accept: NOT in the reference
